blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
While modern AI detectors identify who wrote the words , emerging policies on AI use increasingly hinge on a different question: who came up with the ideas? We introduce IdeaLens , a detector that identifies whether a document’s ideas came from a human or AI ( idea provenance ), regardless of who wrote its words. To focus IdeaLens on ideas rather than prose, we represent documents as outlines: lists of items that each pair a discourse role with a brief, paraphrased description of the content, minimizing word-level overlap with the raw text. We train IdeaLens on 1M FineWeb documents with silver labels from Pangram, a prose provenance detector. Since the outlines are largely stripped of surface-level information, the labels must be fit mainly through the ideas.
In a controlled study, IdeaLens ’s AI flag rate drops from 95% to 7% as models write from increasingly detailed human plans, while Pangram 4 still flags 92%; from AI-derived plans, IdeaLens stays above 96%. Conversely, on a new dataset of 50 stories that human authors wrote from AI-generated plans, IdeaLens flags 68% of the stories as AI, compared to 8% for Pangram 4. On a comprehensive suite of 19 existing detection benchmarks, we show that IdeaLens maintains strong detection rates at low false positive rates, suggesting that ideas themselves provide a powerful discriminative signal, and its performance holds across domains, formats, and languages.
Finally, we examine 90K predictions from IdeaLens to characterize systematic differences between human and AI ideation. We release our models and labeled datasets to facilitate future research on idea provenance detection.
blocks.zh:
虽然现代AI探测器确定谁写出这些词, 我们介绍IdeaLens, 这个探测器能识别文件的想法来自人类还是AI(想法来源), 为了将IdeaLens的焦点放在思想上而不是取道上,我们以文件为大纲:将每个内容与内容的简短的,被诠释的描述相配对的条目列表,将字级与原始文本的重叠降到最低. 我们训练IdeaLens在1M FineWeb文档上使用来自Pangram的银色标签,一个道具出处探测器. 由于提纲基本上被剥去地表级信息,所以标签必须主要通过想法来适应.
在一项受控的研究中,IdeaLens的AI旗率从95%下降到了7%,因为模型来自越来越详细的人类计划,而Pangram 4仍然标有92%;从AI衍生出的计划中,IdeaLens仍然保持在96%以上. 相反地,在由人类作者从AI生成的计划中所写出50个故事的新数据集上,IdeaLens将68%的故事标为AI,而Pangram 4则标为8%. 在一套包含19个现有检测基准的综合中,我们显示,IdeaLens以低假正率维持了强大的检测率,这表明思想本身提供了强大的歧视信号,其性能在各个领域、格式和语言中都有所体现。
最后,我们研究了来自IdeaLens的90K预测,以描述人类和AI思想之间的系统差异. 我们发布我们的模型和标有标签的数据集,以便于未来研究想法出处检测.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Figure 1: IdeaLens tracks ideas; traditional detectors track wording. We present the four quadrants covering both shared provenance (fully human or fully AI) and mixed provenance (human ideas and AI prose, or AI ideas and human prose) scenarios. Unlike traditional detectors (e.g., Pangram 4, glickenhaus2026pangram4technicalreport ; EditLens-3B, thai2026editlens ), IdeaLens can accurately detect the source of ideas, not the source of the prose. IdeaLens classifies 94.7% of AI-generated documents based on human ideas as human, while Pangram labels only 43.8% as human. On our new dataset of human-written stories following AI ideas (§ 3 ), IdeaLens flags 68.0% as AI, compared to Pangram and EditLens flagging only 8.0% and 0.0%, respectively.
blocks.zh: 图1:思想 伦斯追踪想法;传统探测器追踪措辞. 我们介绍四个四重奏,既包括共同出处(完全属于人类或完全属于AI),也包括混合出处(人类思想和AI通用语,即AI通用语和人类通用语). 与传统探测器不同(例如:Plangram 4, glickenhaus2026pangram4 Technicalreport; EditLens-3B, thai2026editlens),IdeaLens能够精确地探测出思想的来源,而不是传道的来源. IdeaLens根据人类思想将94.7%的AI生成的文件归类为人,而Pangram的标签仅将43.8%归类为人. 与Pangram和EditLens分别只标出8.0%和0.0 %。

blocks.en:
In August 2026, the AI detector Pangram flagged a Wall Street Journal op-ed ( druckenmiller2026bond ) by billionaire investor Stanley Druckenmiller as 100% AI-generated, to which
Druckenmiller unapologetically responded: “Of course I used AI” ( stein2026druckenmiller ) . Paul Gigot, the editor of WSJ’s editorial pages, defended Druckenmiller by arguing
that what matters is whether an op-ed “reflects an author’s original argument” and that “nobody can doubt
that his op-ed is his genuine opinion” ( wapo2026wsjai ) , though he provided no supporting evidence from the writing process (e.g., chat logs). Detectors like Pangram answer only who wrote the words ( prose provenance ), while Gigot’s defense, like many emerging policies on AI use in writing ( springernature2026ai ; iclr2027aipolicy ) , hinges on who came up with the ideas ( idea provenance ). 1 1 1 IdeaLens flags the op-ed’s ideas as AI-generated, with P(AI) of 98.3 % 98.3\% against a decision threshold of 86.3%. This is a model prediction and of course does
not constitute direct evidence of the writing process.

blocks.en: Idea and prose provenance can differ within the same document: a human can brainstorm the ideas for a document and ask an AI to write it, or vice versa. Prior work separates the two by building detectors around simulated human–AI collaborations, such as human writing polished by AI or AI writing run through humanizers ( Bao2025DecouplingCA ; li-etal-2026-beyond-final ) . These simulations are expensive to create at scale, and detectors trained on them may not transfer to real collaborations. In contrast, prose detectors like Pangram are trained on documents whose ideas and words come from the same source, which are cheap to collect: human text can be sampled from the pre-ChatGPT era, and AI text can be generated on demand.
blocks.zh: 同一份文件中,思想和道教来源可能有所不同:一个人可以将文件的想法集成为脑筋,要求AI写作,反之亦然. 先前的工作通过在模拟的人类-AI协作周围建造探测器来将两者分开,例如由AI所抛出的人文写作或由人文化者所运行的AI写作(Bao2025DecouplingCA;li-etal-2026-beyond-final). 这些模拟器在规模上创造成本很高,为此而训练的探测器可能不会转移到真正的协作. 相形之下,像"Pangram"这样的道具探测器则被训练出其思想和文字来自同源的文档,这些文档是廉价的来收集的:人类文本可以从ChatGPT之前的时代取出样本,而AI文本可以根据需求生成.

blocks.en:
We propose IdeaLens , an idea provenance detector that learns from the same cheap labels as prose detectors and can therefore be trained at their scale. Our key methodological contribution is to change the classifier’s input . Following the cognitive process model of writing ( FlowerHayes1981 ; hayes2012 ) , we define a document’s ideas as what its author decided to say
(e.g., its claims, events, and organization), as opposed to
the words used to say it. We represent these ideas as an outline whose items each consist of a discourse role paired with a short description of its content, paraphrased to remove the original wording ( Figure 2 ). We train IdeaLens on a dataset of 1M outlines extracted from FineWeb ( penedo2024the ) documents, with silver labels from Pangram. As a control, we also train a separate model, ProseLens , with the same backbone,
documents, and labels, but on the raw text instead of outlines. Despite identical supervision, the
two behave in opposite ways whenever a document’s ideas and words come from different
sources, showing that the
outline forces IdeaLens to fit the labels through ideas rather than words.

blocks.en:
• IdeaLens detects human ideas in AI-generated documents. On a dataset of AI documents generated from increasingly detailed human plans, IdeaLens ’s flag rate falls from 94.9% with minimal human input to 6.8% with a full human outline, while remaining above 96% when plans come instead from AI. ProseLens and Pangram 4 flag 86.5% and 92.4% of documents generated from full human outlines.
This behavior is further supported by results on 10 external benchmarks of AI polishing,
paraphrasing, and rewriting, where IdeaLens flags 5.6% of documents on average,
versus 46.0% for ProseLens and 52.0% for Pangram. • IdeaLens detects AI ideas in human writing. The opposite scenario is harder to study: prior work touches on it only through AI text that people or models edit. To this end, we collect the first dataset of long-form documents that people wrote from scratch following AI ideas. Our dataset contains 50 stories, each written from an outline extracted from an AI-generated story, without access to the raw text of that story. IdeaLens flags 68.0% of the human-written stories and 96.0% of the AI originals, while ProseLens and Pangram flag all of the AI original stories but only 0% and 8.0% of the human-written stories, respectively ( Figure 1 ). • Despite not seeing the raw text, IdeaLens rivals the strongest open-source detector on conventional benchmarks and transfers across 24 languages. On 19 evaluations that require separating fully AI (ideas and writing) from fully human documents, IdeaLens flags 91.1% of AI documents on average with a false positive rate of 0.6%, compared to 81.8% and 0.2% for EditLens-3B, the strongest existing open-weight detector. ProseLens is even stronger here (98.9% and 0.7%), rivaling the commercial Pangram 4 at its published threshold (97.3% and 0.3%). Although trained only on English, IdeaLens transfers to 24
languages through English outlines, detecting 95.3% of AI documents on average at a false positive rate of 0.1% compared with 82.5% and 0.0% for ProseLens . • IdeaLens flags ideas whose details could apply to anything or can’t be
verified. Based on an analysis of 90K item-level predictions, we find that IdeaLens scores ideas as
more AI when
they cite numbers or methods without the context needed to check them, or claim more
than their evidence supports. IdeaLens scores ideas as more human when they include specific sources that a reader could look up or discuss downsides and open problems.

blocks.en: 2 Learning Idea Provenance from Outlines
blocks.zh: 2 从大纲中证明的学习思想

blocks.en: The fundamental challenge in training an idea detector is that we have no large-scale labels for who came up with a document’s ideas, only for who wrote its prose. Thus, we train on prose labels while replacing each document with an outline that preserves its ideas but not its wording. To create these outlines ( Figure 2 ), we identify discourse roles typical of each writing format, use them to extract an outline of each document, and paraphrase the outline to remove wording copied from the raw document. We train IdeaLens to predict each document’s Pangram label from its paraphrased outline, while ProseLens predicts the same labels from the raw document.
blocks.zh: 训练一个思想探测器的根本挑战是,我们没有给谁提出文件的想法,而只给谁写出文件的通用语的标签。 因此,我们在宣传标签方面进行培训,同时用一个纲要来取而代之,该纲要保留其想法而不是其措辞。 为了创建这些大纲(图2),我们确定每个写作格式典型的语句角色,用它们来取出每个文档的大纲,并解说大纲去掉从原始文档中复制来的措辞. 我们训练IdeaLens从它的被解释的大纲中预测每个文档的Pangram标签,而ProseLens则从原始文档中预测相同的标签.

blocks.en: We sample a 1M subset from WildAI ( russell2026aitoken ) , which labels documents from FineWeb ( penedo2024the ) with WebOrganizer ( wettig2025weborganizer ) formats and topics along with authorship labels from Pangram 3.3.2 ( thai2026editlens ) . 2 2 2 We note that Pangram 3.3.2 only provides training labels, while our evaluations benchmark IdeaLens and ProseLens against the more recent Pangram 4. We focus on long-form writing, selecting English documents of at least 500 words that belong to one of eight relevant WebOrganizer formats ( ), and that Pangram labels as either human-written or AI-generated. We assume that the ideas and prose in these documents share the same source, which enables us to use them as noisy silver labels for idea provenance. We discard documents that Pangram labels as mixed , since AI only wrote part of these texts and thus idea provenance is unclear. We split WildOutlines, the full corpus of 1M documents into training ( ∼ \sim 842k), validation ( ∼ \sim 30k), calibration ( ∼ \sim 80k, human documents only) 3 3 3 The calibration split is used to set a threshold for each detector, which turns its predicted probabilities into binary decisions (AI vs. human). Because the calibration split only contains human-written documents, we can set the threshold to achieve a target false positive rate (FPR). Unless explicitly stated otherwise, we report detector accuracy at thresholds calibrated for an FPR of 1%. and test ( ∼ \sim 50k) sets ( ). 4 4 4 Building the corpus cost about $66.4k (§ ).

blocks.en:
Cognitive models of writing ( FlowerHayes1981 ; hayes2012 ) separate the act of planning from the act of translating these plans into prose. To build a document representation of the former without the latter, we turn to discourse theory, which describes the roles a passage plays within the broader context of the document, for example through rhetorical structure theory ( MANNTHOMPSON+1988+243+281 ; Mann2006 ) . We represent a document as an outline : an ordered list of discourse roles, each paired with brief descriptions of how those roles are implemented in the document. For example, the op-ed displayed in Figure 2 contains 17 items, starting with an Event Account of a Treasury announcement followed by an Evaluation of the market’s reaction.
Many of these roles are format-specific ( swales1990genre ; SunWangXiong+2021+599+624 ; van2019macrostructures ) ; for instance, creative writing uses different roles than nonfiction. Thus, we induce separate role sets for each of the eight formats in our dataset ( ).
blocks.zh:
认知的写作模式(FlowerHayes1981; hayes2012 )将规划行为与将这些计划转化为传道行为区分开来. 为了建立一个没有后者的文件代表,我们转而讨论论述理论,它描述了一段段落在该文件更广泛的背景下发挥的作用,例如通过修辞结构理论(MANNTHOMPSON+1988+243+281;Mann2006). 我们代表一份文件,作为纲要:一个有序的讨论角色清单,其中每一个角色都附有如何在文件中落实这些角色的简要说明。 例如,图2中显示的论坛版包含17个项目,首先是财务处公告的事件账户,然后是市场反应评估。
许多这些角色都是格式特异性的(swales1990genre;SunWangXiong+2021+599+624;van2019macrostructures ;);例如,创意写作使用的角色与非虚构不同. 因此,我们在我们的数据集中为八种格式中的每一种分别引入了各自的角色集(.).

blocks.en: We build a training dataset, WildOutlines , for IdeaLens by converting documents to outlines in three automated steps:
blocks.zh: 我们为IdeaLens建立一个培训数据集, 将文档转换为三个自动化步骤的大纲:

blocks.en: (i) Role induction: We adapt the TopicGPT framework ( pham2024topicgptpromptbasedtopicmodeling ) by prompting GPT-5.6 Sol ( openai2026gpt56 ) to propose base roles for each format given a detailed description of that format. Then, we label outlines of 200 documents in that format using those roles, while asking the model to invent new roles as needed. Afterwards, we deduplicate and prune the resulting role set (e.g., to 42 roles for nonfiction); more details in § . (ii) Outline extraction: Given a document, we prompt Gemini 3.7 Flash and Gemini 3.1 Pro ( gemini2023 ; gemini37flash ; gemini31pro ) with its format’s role set (and few-shot demonstrations from the much more powerful Claude Fable 5 ( anthropic2026fable5 ) ) to produce an outline of the document’s ideas in order, where each item consists of a role and a short content description. (iii) Paraphrasing: Extracted outlines can copy phrasing from the original document, which a model could use as a stylistic shortcut to the label (i.e., human wording can leak into the outlines). Therefore, we prompt Gemini 3.1 Pro ( gemini31pro ) to paraphrase each outline. This pushes all outlines toward a homogeneous, AI-like style: for human-written documents, the fraction of outline text that Pangram 4 labels as human drops from 8.5% to 0.3% ( ). Meaning is still preserved ( ), as paraphrased outlines have a cosine similarity of 0.93 with the originally extracted outlines (vs. 0.39 for unrelated outlines) and 0.76 with the source document (vs. 0.26). We paraphrase only for training, to keep the model from learning style; at inference, IdeaLens sees the unparaphrased outline.
blocks.zh: (一) 角色简介: 我们调整了专题GPT框架(pham2024topicgptptprompt basedtopical modeling ),促使GPT-5.6 Sol(openai2026gpt56)为每种格式提出基本作用,并详细描述该格式。 然后,我们用这种格式给200个文件的提纲贴上标签,同时要求模型根据需要创造出新的作用。 之后,我们将由此产生的角色集(例如,非虚构角色为42个)加以分解并简化;详见§. blocks.en: Both of our models start from a backbone of Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B ( nvidia2026nemotron35lightning ) , fine-tuned for one epoch with LoRA ( hu2022lora ) using Tinker ( tml2026tinker ) . 5 5 5 Details and results for other backbones are in § . We threshold each model’s probability that a document is AI-generated at a 1% false positive rate on our calibration split. The only difference between the two models is that IdeaLens is trained on paraphrased outlines, whereas ProseLens is trained on the original documents. Since they share their backbone, training documents, and labels, any difference in their behavior is a direct result of transforming the input into our outline representation.
blocks.zh: 我们的两个模型都从Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B(nvidia2026nemotron35lightning)的骨干开始,用Tinker(tml2026tinker)对Lora(hu2022lora)的一个时代进行了微调. 5 5 5 其他骨干的细节和结果都在§. 我们确定每个模型的概率, 即一个文件是人工智能生成的, 这两个模型的唯一区别是,IdeaLens接受过被解释的大纲培训,而ProseLens则接受过原始文件培训. 由于他们分享他们的骨干,训练文件和标签,他们的行为上的任何区别,都是将投入转化为我们提纲代表的直接结果.

blocks.en: 3 Experimental setup
blocks.zh: 3 实验设置

blocks.en:
We evaluate IdeaLens and ProseLens against 17 existing detectors, including the state-of-the-art Pangram 4, on 19 external benchmarks and three datasets that we create ourselves: IdeaShift , IdeaShift-X , and TwiceTold .
These datasets cover all four quadrants in Figure 1 : documents with shared provenance (fully human or fully AI) as well as documents with mixed provenance (human ideas and AI prose, or AI ideas and human prose). Idea detectors should achieve high accuracy in all four quadrants, while prose detectors should fail in the two mixed quadrants.
blocks.zh:
我们根据19个外部基准和我们自己创建的三套数据集,
这些数据集涵盖了图1中的所有四个四重体:具有共同出处的文件(完全属于人或完全属于AI),以及具有混合出处的文件(人的思想和AI的道具,或AI的思想和人类道具). 思想探测器应该在所有四个象限中达到高精度,而道具探测器应该在两个混合象限中失效.

blocks.en:
We report accuracy at detecting AI ideas, which we define as the percentage of documents whose predicted label (AI or human) agrees with the source of their ideas.
Our baselines include Pangram 4 ( glickenhaus2026pangram4technicalreport ) , EditLens-Llama-3.2-3B ( thai2026editlens ) , Fast-DetectGPT ( bao2024fastdetectgpt ) , Binoculars ( hans2024spotting ) , MELD ( li2026meldmultitaskequilibratedlearning ) and Desklib ( desklib2025aitextdetector ) . For IdeaLens , ProseLens , and EditLens, we set a global threshold across all formats at 1% FPR on our calibration set. We binarize Pangram’s ternary labels (AI, AI-assisted, human) following its tech report, and other baselines use their default thresholds. 6 6 6 Details on thresholding, including the Pangram conversion, are in § .
blocks.zh:
我们报告在发现AI想法时的准确性,我们将其定义为预言标签(AI或人类)同意其想法来源的文件的百分比.
我们的基线包括Pagram 4 (glickenhaus2026pangram4Technicalreport), EditLens-Llama-3.2-3B (thai2026editlens), 快速检测GPT(bao2024fastdetectgpt ), Binocules (hans2024 spotting ),MELD (li2026meld multitaskequilibrated learning )和Officelib(Officelib2025aitext detector ). 对于IdeaLens,ProseLens,以及EditLens,我们设定了所有格式的全球阈值,在我们的校正集上为1%的FPR. 在Pangram的技术报告之后, 我们把Pangram的三重标签(AI、AI-Aid、Human)二分法化, 其他基线则使用默认阈值。 6 6 有关阈值的详情,包括Pangram转换,载于§.

blocks.en: Of the 19 external detection benchmarks (see § for full list), 14 contain documents with shared provenance (fully human or fully AI). We evaluate accuracy on these documents and on our in-domain test set of 50K documents from our Pangram-labeled web corpus. We also measure FPR on a set of 10K documents from C4 ( c4dataset ) , which was created prior to ChatGPT’s release and is thus much more likely to be human-written than our silver-labeled test set. Finally, 10 external benchmarks also contain documents written by humans but edited by an AI (e.g., via paraphrasing, polishing, or rewriting), which we use as instances of human ideas rendered in AI prose; this includes OpAI-Bench ( Bsharat2026OperationGuidedPH ) and GEDE ( Gehring2025LimitsOL ) .
blocks.zh: 在19项外部检测基准(完整清单见§)中,14项包含有共同来源的文件(完全属于人或完全属于AI)。 我们评价这些文件的准确性 以及我们从标有Pangram的网页中 测试的50K文件的准确性 我们还用一套来自C4 (c4dataset)的10K文件来测量FPR, 这套文件是在ChatGPT发布前创建的, 最后,10个外部基准还包含由人类撰写、但由AI编辑的文件(例如,通过抛写、抛光或重写),我们用这些文件作为人工引言中人类思想的例子;其中包括OPAI-Bench(Bsharat2026 Operation GuidedPH)和GEDE(Gehring2025LimitsOL)。

blocks.en:
A common collaborative writing pattern is for a human to give an AI their ideas via a prompt, which it uses to write a document from scratch ( 10.1145/3698061.3726910 ) .
Only two external datasets we evaluate on contain instances of this pattern ( saha2026policies ; Gehring2025LimitsOL ) , and neither controls the amount of human input, so it is unclear how much of the final document’s ideas came from the human. Thus, we create IdeaShift from 500 seed documents (both human-written and AI-generated) sampled from our in-domain test set. For each seed document, GPT-5.6 Sol ( openai2026gpt56 ) writes five progressively more detailed prompts: the level-0 prompt contains only the topic (e.g., “Write a dining and lifestyle blog post reviewing a restaurant visit.”), while the level-5 prompt contains the full outline extracted as per § 2 with instructions to add nothing else to it. GPT-5.6 models then generate a new document for each prompt. Since all of the prose in IdeaShift is AI-generated, prose detectors should flag every document as AI, and an idea detector should do the same for AI seeds. However, on documents generated from human seeds, idea detectors should flag fewer and fewer documents as the prompts carry more of the human plan.
blocks.zh:
一个常见的合作写作模式是人类通过一个即时给出AI的想法,它用来从头写出文件(10.1145/3698061.3726910.
我们只评价两个外部数据集包含这种模式的例子(saha2026 policys;Gehring2025LimitsOL ),两者都无法控制人类投入的数量,因此目前还不清楚最终文件的理念有多少来自人类. 因此,我们从500个种子文件(既包括人文文件,也包括人工生成的AI文件)中创建了IdeaShift,取自我们域内测试集的样本. 对于每个种子文件,GPT-5.6 Sol(openai2026gpt56 )写出五个更相近的提示:pal-0的提示只包含主题(例如,“写一个餐饮和生活方式博客文章,审查餐厅的访问.”),而pal-5的提示则包含根据§2所提取的完整大纲,并指示不要添加其他内容. GPT-5.6型号然后为每个快件生成新文档. 由于IdeaShift中所有的道具都是AI所生成的,道具探测器应该将每个文档都标为AI,一个想法探测器也应该为AI种子做同样的事情. 然而,对于由人类种子产生的文件,思想探测器应该标出越来越少的文件,因为提示载有更多的人类计划.

blocks.en: We are also interested in the reverse pattern: a human obtains ideas from an AI and then writes the document themselves. Existing datasets approximate this pattern with AI-generated text that humans edit or AI tools humanize, 7 7 7 E.g., LAMP ( LAMP ) , HART ( Bao2025DecouplingCA ) , and baumler-etal-2026-make . but these edited documents are still largely AI-generated and thus do not cleanly separate idea and prose provenance. To fill this gap, we create TwiceTold , 8 8 8 Named after Twice-Told Tales , a collection of previously published short stories by Nathaniel Hawthorne. a dataset with 50 stories written from scratch by humans given only the outline of a 500-word story generated by GPT-5.6 Sol (see § for more details). 9 9 9 The stories were written in person by 17 computer science graduate students or faculty. We avoided crowdsourcing to reduce the chance of AI use during the writing process ( 10.1145/3685527 ) . Prose detectors should label these stories as human, while idea detectors should label them as AI. We also include the 50 original AI stories, which all detectors should label as AI.
blocks.zh: 我们还对反向模式感兴趣:一个人从AI那里得到想法,然后自己写出文件。 现有数据集与人工智能生成的人类编辑或人工智能工具人性化的文本相近,7 7 E.,LAMP (LAMP),HART (Bao2025DecouplingCA),和baumler-etal-2026-make .但这些被编辑的文件基本上仍然是人工智能生成的,因此不干净地分开思想和道具出处. 为了填补这个空白, 我们创建了TwitchTold, 8 8 以Tword Tales命名, 一个由人类从头写出50个故事的数据集,只给出了由GPT-5.6 Sol(详见§)生成的500个字故事的大纲. 第9条 9 这些故事是由17名计算机科学研究生或系主任亲自撰写的。 我们避免了众包,以减少在写作过程中使用AI的机会(10.1145/3685527. Prose探测器应该将这些故事贴上人类的标签,而思想探测器应该贴上AI的标签. 我们还包括了50个最初的AI故事,所有探测器都应该标注为AI.

blocks.en: While prose detectors rely on language-specific features (e.g., vocabulary choice, sentence structure), IdeaLens uses an LLM extractor that can generate English outlines for documents in any language. Thus, even though IdeaLens is trained only on English documents, we can apply it to documents in other languages without any additional training. To test this, we create IdeaShift-X by sampling 10K human-authored documents in 24 languages ( ) from FineWeb2 ( penedo2025fineweb ) , to measure FPR across different languages. For each, we follow the IdeaShift protocol to generate AI versions in the original language at level 0 (AI ideas) and level 5 (human ideas).
blocks.zh: 虽然道具检测器依赖于语言特有的特征(例如词汇选择,句子结构),但IdeaLens使用LLM提取器,可以生成任何语言中文档的英文大纲. 因此,即使IdeaLens只接受关于英文文件的培训,我们也可以将其应用于其他语文的文件,而无需再接受任何培训。 为了测试这一点,我们用来自FineWeb2(pinedo2025fineweb)的24种语言的10K人类著作样本创建了IdeaShift-X,以测量不同语言的FPR. 对于每一个,我们遵循IdeaShift协议,在0级(AI思想)和5级(人类思想)生成原语言的AI版本.

blocks.en: 4 IdeaLens detects AI ideas, not AI prose
blocks.zh: 4 IdeaLens 检测AI的想法,而不是AI改口

blocks.en:
footnote 11 summarizes our main results across 51 evaluation splits from 22 benchmarks, where each point is a detector plotted by its aggregate idea detection accuracy on documents with shared vs. mixed provenance. IdeaLens is the only detector that achieves high accuracy in both shared (95.3%) and mixed (81.3%) settings. ProseLens and Pangram 4 are extremely accurate on documents with shared provenance (99.1% and 98.5%, respectively) but fail to identify the source of a document’s ideas in mixed settings (25.4% and 25.9%).
Since ProseLens has the same backbone, training documents, and training labels as IdeaLens , this highlights the impact of our outline representation, which a ModernBERT-based pair ( warner-etal-2025-smarter ) replicates with a different backbone. IdeaLens also transfers unexpectedly well to raw text inputs at test time, exhibiting high shared provenance accuracy and substantially higher mixed provenance accuracy than ProseLens .
blocks.zh:
脚注11总结了我们从22个基准分为51个评价的主要结果,其中每个点都是一个探测器,由其在共用来源与混合来源文件上的总体想法探测精度所绘制。 IdeaLens是唯一在共享(95.3%)和混合(81.3%)设置中都实现高精度的探测器. ProseLens和Pagram 4对于共同来源的文件(分别为99.1%和98.5%)非常准确,但未能在混合环境中确定文件思想的来源(25.4%和25.9%)。
由于ProseLens与IdeaLens有着相同的骨干,训练文件,以及训练标签,这凸显出我们大纲代表的影响,一个基于现代BERT的对子(warranter-etal-2025-smarter)用不同的骨干来复制. IdeaLens还意外地在测试时顺利地转移到了原始文本输入,显示出高度共享的出处精度和远高于ProseLens的混合出处精度.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Outline-trained IdeaLens detects idea authorship while traditional detectors track prose authorship. The average accuracy across all benchmarks where ideas and prose are shared by one author (x-axis) and where they are by different authors (y-axis). IdeaLens is the only detector accurate with both shared (95.3%) and mixed (81.3%) authorship. 11 11 11 With weighted average accuracy, IdeaLens is more accurate at 92.6% compared to ProseLens ’s 46.8% and Pangram’s 41.1% on mixed provenance benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 图3 大纲训练的IdeaLens检测出思想作者身份,而传统探测器跟踪传道作者身份. 所有基准的平均准确性,其中思想和道教由一个作者共享(x轴),而不同作者共享(y轴). IdeaLens是唯一精确的探测器,其拥有共享(95.3%)和混合(81.3%)的著作权。 11 11 具有加权平均精确度,IdeaLens的精确度为92.6%,而ProseLens的精确度为46.8%,Pangram的精确度为41.1%。

blocks.en: As the human plan in the prompts from IdeaShift becomes more detailed, IdeaLens ’s flag rate drops from 94.9% at level 0 to 6.8% at level 5 ( 4(a) ). In contrast, ProseLens and Pangram 4 flag 86–100% of documents regardless of the level of human ideation. When the plans come from AI instead of humans, IdeaLens consistently flags more than 96% of documents at every level ( ), showing that it is sensitive to idea provenance rather than level of prompt detail. Finally, we observe that the biggest drop in flag rate occurs between levels 3 and 4, which is when the prompts begin including outlines with content in addition to structural role information ( ).
blocks.zh: 随着来自IdeaShift的提示中的人类计划变得更加详细,IdeaLens的旗帜率从0级的94.9%下降到了5级(4(a))的6.8%. 相比之下,ProseLens和Pangram 4旗的文档无论人的思想水平如何,都达到了86-100%. 当计划来自AI而不是人类时,IdeaLens在每一级别(.)持续地标出超过96%的文档,表明对思想出处的敏感,而不是及时的细节水平. 最后,我们观察到,国旗率最大的下降发生在第三级和第四级之间,即当提示开始包括除结构角色信息外内容的大纲时(.).

blocks.en:
Aggregated over 12 benchmarks
where AI makes surface-level changes to human text (e.g., polishing, paraphrasing), IdeaLens labels 94.7% of documents as human, compared to 50.7% for ProseLens and 43.8% for Pangram 4 ( ). In GEDE ( Gehring2025LimitsOL ) , IdeaLens flags only 0.5% of human essays as AI after minor corrections made by an LLM (vs Pangram 4’s 54.6% and ProseLens ’s 45.8%) and 2.6% after a rewrite preserving the original content (vs Pangram 4’s 94.3% and ProseLens ’s 77.1%). In HART ( Bao2025DecouplingCA ) , IdeaLens flags 4.9% of LLM paraphrases of human documents, compared to 42.8% by Pangram 4 and 44.5% by ProseLens . In the Academic Integrity dataset ( Karr2026WhyAD ) , it flags 8.2% of abstracts that an LLM generated from a human-written reference abstract, compared to Pangram 4’s 96.4% and ProseLens ’s 83.9%.

blocks.en: IdeaLens flags 68% (95% CI 54–79%) of TwiceTold stories as AI, compared to 0% for ProseLens and 8% for Pangram 4. 12 12 12 Pangram 4’s flags are likely due to usage of character names typical of AI writing (e.g., Mara , Bellweather ). All detectors are reliable at flagging the AI-generated original stories (96% for IdeaLens and 100% for ProseLens and Pangram), but only IdeaLens sticks with its prediction for the majority of the human stories, even though the prose is completely different ( 4(b) ). The stories that IdeaLens marks as human generally follow their outlines while adding new events or world-building details: 12 out of 16 errors are on stories that contain speculative or fantasy elements.
blocks.zh: 作为AI的"双Told"故事,IdeaLens的旗子为68%(95% CI 54–79%),而"ProseLens"的旗子为0 %,"Pangram4"的旗子为8 %. 12 12 12 Pangram 4的旗子很可能是因为使用AI写作的典型人物名(如马拉,贝尔韦瑟等). 所有探测器在标出AI生成的原始故事(IdeaLens为96%,ProseLens和Pangram为100%)时都是可靠的,但只有IdeaLens在标出它对于大多数人类故事的预测,尽管道词完全不同(4(b). 被IdeaLens标记为人类的故事一般遵循它们的轮廓,同时增加新的事件或世界建设的细节:16个错误中有12个是关于包含投机或幻想元素的故事.

blocks.en:
On 19 evaluation splits with shared provenance, IdeaLens detects 91.1% of AI documents at 0.6% FPR compared with 81.8% at 0.2% FPR for EditLens-3B, 13 13 13 While IdeaLens ’s 30B backbone is larger than EditLens-3B, it is a mixture-of-experts model with only 3B active parameters. Our IdeaLens -ModernBERT variant, with only 0.4B parameters, detects 79.1% of AI documents at an FPR of 1.5%. the strongest existing open baseline ( ), with both calibrated to a 1% target. Training on full text does better: ProseLens reaches 98.9% at 0.7% FPR, rivaling Pangram 4 (97.3% at 0.3%) and making it the strongest open detector in our evaluations.
To cleanly measure FPR, we collect 10K pre-ChatGPT documents from C4: IdeaLens flags only 0.01% compared to 0% for ProseLens and Pangram 4 (§ ).
Against humanization and adversarial attacks, IdeaLens ’s detection rate drops 6.4 points on average, between Pangram’s 4.9 and ProseLens ’s 10.6 ( ). One weakness of IdeaLens is DIPPER paraphrasing ( krishna2023paraphrasing ) in GEDE ( Gehring2025LimitsOL ) , where it detects 77.6% versus 97.1% for ProseLens and 95.1% for Pangram 4; we suspect this attack changes content as well as style (§ ).

为了对FPR进行清洁测量,我们从C4收集了10K的ChatGPT前文件:IdeaLens的旗帜只有0.01%,而ProseLens和Pagram 4(§)则只有0%.
在Pangram的4.9和ProseLens的10.6(.)之间,IdeaLens的探测率平均下降了6.4分。 IdeaLens的一个弱点是GEDE(Gehring2025LimitsOL)中的DIPPER paraphrasing(krishna2023paraphrasing),它检测到ProseLens为77.6%,Plangram4为97.1%;我们怀疑这次攻击会改变内容和风格(§).

blocks.en:
IdeaShift-X contains documents generated in 24 different languages, and IdeaLens flags 95.3% of the level-0 documents but only 0.7% of the level-5 documents despite being trained only on English. These results show that signatures of AI ideas are largely invariant to the language in which they are written. In contrast, prose detectors like ProseLens and Pangram 4 flag 82–85% of level-0 and 45–62% of level-5 documents, and this gap between IdeaLens and these detectors widens in low-resource languages like Tamil and Amharic.
Additionally, IdeaLens achieves a low FPR on non-English human-written documents:
on 10K pre-ChatGPT documents in these 24 languages sampled from FineWeb2 ( penedo2025fineweb ) , it flags only 0.1% as AI ( ).
blocks.zh:
思想 Shift-X包含24种不同语言生成的文档,而IdeaLens旗下为95.3%的0级文档,但只有0.7%的5级文档,尽管只接受了英语培训. 这些结果显示,AI思想的签名与所写语言大相径庭. 相比之下,ProseLens和Pangram 4等道具探测器在0级文档中占82-85%,在5级文档中占45-62%,而IdeaLens与这些探测器之间的差距以泰米尔语和阿姆哈拉克语等低资源语言扩大.
此外,IdeaLens在非英语人文文件上实现了较低的FPR:
